What is this

A catalogue of the obvious, photographed with great respect.

It started, as these things do, over drinks. Packages is a collection of men shot from the collar to the knee — fully clothed — in every material a man owns: denim, sweats, suiting, spandex, the works. Each one comes with a profile: what he does, how old he is, where he's from, a fun fact, and his favorite activity. It's a joke with excellent production values.

The call for packages

Get in the book.

If you've got a package and a sense of humor, you're exactly who we're looking for. Two minutes, one photo, done. No account, no app, nothing to print.

Step one

Snap it

Clothed, collar to knee. Any material — the more surprising the fabric, the better. Good light, no faces required.

Step two

Fill it in

A short profile and an email. Use your real name or an alias — whatever you want printed under it.

Step three

Send it

Tick the box, hit send. You'll get a confirmation straight away, and we'll email before anything is published.

Tap to add your shot JPG, PNG or HEIC · straight from your camera roll, not a screenshot
We only use your email to reach you about the book — never sold, never a mailing list you didn't ask for. Trouble uploading? Email your photo and details to equalitychick@gmail.com instead. Handle with care.

Package received.

Signed for, catalogued, and filed somewhere very safe. A confirmation is on its way to your inbox.

If you make the book, you'll hear from us long before anything goes near a printer.

Thank you, sincerely. It takes a certain confidence to send a stranger a photograph of your trousers.

The author

Meet Anita P. Book.

Anita has been quietly appreciating packages since well before it was a book. A lifelong student of materials and the men in them, she believes the coffee table is a place for honest conversation — and that the best joke is one you can hand someone at a dinner party.

Materials is her first volume. It will not be her last.

The fine print, roughly

Questions, answered.

Is this... tasteful?

Yes. Everyone is fully clothed, it's shot like a product catalogue, and the whole thing is a wink, not a leer. If your grandmother has a sense of humor, she'll love it.

Do I have to show my face?

No. The frame is collar-to-knee. You can use your real name or an alias for your credit line — your call.

What happens to my photo?

We crop and style it to match the book's look, pair it with your profile, and — if selected — include it in the book.

Why do you need a signature?

So we can legally include you in a book that might one day be sold. The release is short, plain-English, signed electronically, and you keep a copy.

When does it come out?

We're in collection now. Drop your email in the form and we'll tell you the moment it ships — and which edition to grab.
